lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 7 distinct high-contrast white vertical lines are visible on the lateral torso. Spacing is non-uniform, with greater pixel-width intervals between anterior lines compared to closer intervals on the posterior section.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A singular Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the second vertical line from the posterior edge, with the split occurring in the upper-third quadrant of the torso mass.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The fourth and fifth lines from the anterior edge exhibit significant discontinuities, appearing as dashed segments that terminate and restart mid-torso.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Low-density cluster of 2 primary high-contrast circular spots located on the mid-lateral posterior haunch.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: The two primary spots on the posterior haunch align to form a downward-sloping diagonal vector relative to the horizontal plane of the torso.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns follow a spiral-lyrate trajectory, initiating at an upward-outward vector from the frontal bone before curving inward at the apical segments.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The terminal span between horn tips is approximately 1.5 times the pixel width of the combined horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory-toned apical segments comprise approximately 10% of the total vertical horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a bird (oxpecker) perched on the mid-dorsal ridge; prominent white facial chevron; distinct shaggy dark-brown ventral hair fringe; high-contrast tan/orange leg coloration below the carpal/tarsal joints.
